english: From {min} to {max} fields (empty rows are skipped). A weight is any number from 1 to {wmax}: a field's chance is its weight over the sum of the weights. english: This share of the bots (fixed, by the character's number) does quests properly: it picks the best quest - on its map first, then one whose target is in its kingdom or on a frontier, where it travels (the Grinder and the droppers do not) - and goes after its target. Of the rest 70% do them on the way (they take and hand in quests at the NPCs of the town and meet the targets in their ordinary hunting) and 30% skip quests. At 50%: 50 / 35 / 15. english: The game client never asks the server what an item is: it reads the item and monster tables from its own pack (pack\gamedata). A change in the database editor - an item's bonuses, its attack values, its NPC price, a monster's level - works on the server after a restart, and the client shows the old values in the item's tooltip, in the sell question and on the target board until it gets this world's tables. This page builds them from world.item_proto and world.mob_proto, and the skills' numbers (mana, cooldown, duration, the effect in the tooltip) from world.skill_proto.
polski: Klient gry nie pyta serwera, czym jest przedmiot: tabelę przedmiotów i potworów czyta z własnej paczki (pack\gamedata). Zmiana w edytorze bazy danych - bonusy przedmiotu, wartości ataku, cena u NPC, poziom potwora - działa na serwerze po restarcie, a klient pokazuje stare wartości w opisie przedmiotu, w pytaniu o sprzedaż i na pasku celu, dopóki nie dostanie tych tabel z tego świata. Ta strona buduje je z world.item_proto i world.mob_proto, a wartości umiejętności (mana, czas odnowienia, czas trwania, efekt w opisie) z world.skill_proto.
translation: Spilklienten spørger aldrig serveren, hvad en genstand er: den læser genstands- og monstertabellerne fra sin egen pack (pack\gamedata). En ændring i databaseeditoren - en genstands bonusser, dens angrebsværdier, dens NPC-pris, et monsters niveau - virker på serveren efter en genstart, og klienten viser de gamle værdier i genstandens tooltip, i salgsspørgsmålet og på måltavlen, indtil den får denne verdens tabeller. Denne side bygger dem ud fra world.item_proto og world.mob_proto, og færdighedernes værdier (mana, nedkøling, varighed, effekten i tooltippet) ud fra world.skill_proto.

translation: Hent ZIP-pakken, og giv den til din ven. De pakker det hele ud i klientmappen (hvor metin2client.exe ligger) og kører DaneSwiata.bat: den tjekker, at klienten er samme version, tager backup af de originale filer og erstatter dem først derefter (tilbage: DaneSwiata.bat restore).
